# Profile settings

<div class="gen-note">Generated from the APS 3.0 source code: every name, pin, default and description below is read from the plugin itself, so it matches what you see in the editor.</div>

Everything an AI perceives, and how sharply, is set on its **Perception Profile** (a Data Asset). These are all of its settings, in the order and groups of its Details panel. A new profile works as it is: every setting has a working default.

## Composition
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="s-parent-profile" data-search="Parent Profile" data-text="Inherit every setting from this profile, keeping only the fields changed here. A field counts as changed when it differs from the class default — exactly the fields the Details panel marks with a revert-to-default arrow. Leave a field alone and it tracks the parent; edit it and it is yours. Start a "><div class="set-head"><b>Parent Profile</b><span class="pin object"><i></i><small>Perception Profile</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>None</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>ParentProfile</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Inherit every setting from this profile, keeping only the fields changed here.</p><p>A field counts as changed when it differs from the class default — exactly the fields the Details panel marks with a revert-to-default arrow. Leave a field alone and it tracks the parent; edit it and it is yours.</p><p>Start a child from a NEW profile rather than a duplicate of the parent. A duplicate carries every one of the parent&#x27;s tuned values as changed fields, so it would inherit nothing and drift the moment the parent moves on.</p><p>To pin a value that happens to equal the class default, put it in Overrides below — that list is read after inheritance and always wins.</p><p>Composition is resolved once, when an agent starts or swaps profiles, into a private copy owned by that agent. Editing the parent therefore affects agents that spawn afterwards, not ones already running.</p><p>Use Show Composition to see exactly which fields are inherited.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-overrides" data-search="Overrides" data-text="Extra changes stamped on after inheritance is resolved. Rarely needed on an asset — editing the field directly is the normal way to override one. This exists for values a Blueprint wants to compute, and it is the same list the component uses for per-agent tweaks."><div class="set-head"><b>Overrides</b><span class="pin struct container"><i></i><small>Array of APSProfile Override</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>Overrides</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Extra changes stamped on after inheritance is resolved.</p><p>Rarely needed on an asset — editing the field directly is the normal way to override one. This exists for values a Blueprint wants to compute, and it is the same list the component uses for per-agent tweaks.</p></div></div></div>

## Fusion
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="s-corroboration-bonus" data-search="Corroboration Bonus" data-text="What each extra sense that reports a target adds on top of the strongest one. Vision 0.8 alone is 0.8; with hearing too, 0.9. 0 uses the strongest sense alone."><div class="set-head"><b>Corroboration Bonus</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.1</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>CorroborationBonus</code></span><span>0 to 0.5</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>What each extra sense that reports a target adds on top of the strongest one. Vision 0.8 alone is 0.8; with hearing too, 0.9. 0 uses the strongest sense alone.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-confidence-rise-rate" data-search="Confidence Rise Rate" data-text="How fast confidence rises toward what the senses report. Higher is snappier detection."><div class="set-head"><b>Confidence Rise Rate</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>5</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>ConfidenceRiseRate</code></span><span>0.01 to 10</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>How fast confidence rises toward what the senses report. Higher is snappier detection.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-confidence-decay-smoothing" data-search="Confidence Decay Smoothing" data-text="Not read by APS 3.0."><div class="set-head"><b>Confidence Decay Smoothing</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>1.5</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>ConfidenceDecaySmoothing</code></span><span>0.01 to 10</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p class="inert-why"><b>Does nothing in APS 3.0.</b> No code reads it. Use Confidence Rise Rate, and each sense&#x27;s Confidence Decay Multiplier in the Loss settings.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-standing-dwell-rate" data-search="Standing Dwell Rate" data-text="Extra confidence per second, while the AI keeps sensing a target standing still: the longer it looks, the surer it gets (never above what the senses report)."><div class="set-head"><b>Standing Dwell Rate</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.02</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>StandingDwellRate</code></span><span>0.01 to 1</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Extra confidence per second, while the AI keeps sensing a target standing still: the longer it looks, the surer it gets (never above what the senses report).</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-moving-dwell-rate" data-search="Moving Dwell Rate" data-text="The same for a target moving fast (600 cm/s or more); speeds in between blend the two.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-confidence-reduce-delay" data-search="Confidence Reduce Delay" data-text="Not read by APS 3.0."><div class="set-head"><b>Confidence Reduce Delay</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>3</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>ConfidenceReduceDelay</code></span><span>0 to 10</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p class="inert-why"><b>Does nothing in APS 3.0.</b> No code reads it. Use Confidence Rise Rate, and each sense&#x27;s Confidence Decay Multiplier in the Loss settings.</p></div></div></div>

## Memory

### Crowd
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="s-enable-statistical-tier" data-search="Enable Statistical Tier" data-text="Let distant AI (from Statistical Tier Threshold) perceive by chance instead of tracing: cheap, but it doesn&#x27;t see walls, so a statistical AI can notice through them."><div class="set-head"><b>Enable Statistical Tier</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>Off</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>bEnableStatisticalTier</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Let distant AI (from Statistical Tier Threshold) perceive by chance instead of tracing: cheap, but it doesn&#x27;t see walls, so a statistical AI can notice through them.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-statistical-tier-threshold" data-search="Statistical Tier Threshold" data-text="The level of detail tier from which an AI goes statistical. At 3 only distant, unengaged AI do (for an idle AI, beyond about 150 m)."><div class="set-head"><b>Statistical Tier Threshold</b><span class="pin int"><i></i><small>Integer</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>3</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>StatisticalTierThreshold</code></span><span>1 to 4</span><span class="when">only when Enable Statistical Tier is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>The level of detail tier from which an AI goes statistical. At 3 only distant, unengaged AI do (for an idle AI, beyond about 150 m).</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-statistical-detection-rate" data-search="Statistical Detection Rate" data-text="Chance per second of noticing an ideally-placed target — close, lit, moving. Everything else scales this down."><div class="set-head"><b>Statistical Detection Rate</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>1</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>StatisticalDetectionRate</code></span><span>0 to 10</span><span class="when">only when Enable Statistical Tier is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Chance per second of noticing an ideally-placed target — close, lit, moving. Everything else scales this down.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-statistical-detection-confidence" data-search="Statistical Detection Confidence" data-text="Confidence granted when a statistical detection lands. Deliberately modest: a distant agent that half-noticed something should be suspicious, not certain."><div class="set-head"><b>Statistical Detection Confidence</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.5</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>StatisticalDetectionConfidence</code></span><span>0 to 1</span><span class="when">only when Enable Statistical Tier is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Confidence granted when a statistical detection lands. Deliberately modest: a distant agent that half-noticed something should be suspicious, not certain.</p></div></div></div>

## Fairness
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="s-first-spot-reaction-time" data-search="First Spot Reaction Time" data-text="Seconds the AI must keep sensing a target it doesn&#x27;t know yet before confidence starts to count: a beat for the player to step back. Only until it first suspects that target. 0 is instant."><div class="set-head"><b>First Spot Reaction Time</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>FirstSpotReactionTime</code></span><span>0 to 5</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Seconds the AI must keep sensing a target it doesn&#x27;t know yet before confidence starts to count: a beat for the player to step back. Only until it first suspects that target. 0 is instant.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-telegraph-threshold" data-search="Telegraph Threshold" data-text="The confidence at which On AI Telegraph fires: a warning before the AI commits. Keep it between Suspect Threshold and Detect Threshold.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-offscreen-hearing-penalty" data-search="Offscreen Hearing Penalty" data-text="Hear worse while this AI is off the first player&#x27;s screen (more than about 75° from where the camera points)."><div class="set-head"><b>Offscreen Hearing Penalty</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>Off</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>bOffscreenHearingPenalty</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Hear worse while this AI is off the first player&#x27;s screen (more than about 75° from where the camera points).</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-offscreen-hearing-multiplier" data-search="Offscreen Hearing Multiplier" data-text="How much of its hearing an off-screen AI keeps, 0 to 1."><div class="set-head"><b>Offscreen Hearing Multiplier</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.75</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>OffscreenHearingMultiplier</code></span><span>0 to 1</span><span class="when">only when Offscreen Hearing Penalty is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>How much of its hearing an off-screen AI keeps, 0 to 1.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-respect-never-search-zones" data-search="Respect Never Search Zones" data-text="Whether this AI&#x27;s Is Location in Never Search Zone answers. APS enforces nothing by itself."><div class="set-head"><b>Respect Never Search Zones</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>On</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>bRespectNeverSearchZones</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Whether this AI&#x27;s Is Location in Never Search Zone answers. Off: it always answers false. APS enforces nothing by itself.</p></div></div></div>

## Replication
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="s-replicate-perception-state" data-search="Replicate Perception State" data-text="Replicate a compact per-target perception summary to clients so client-side detection meters, HUD and spectator tools work without custom plumbing. Perception itself stays server-authoritative.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-max-replicated-targets" data-search="Max Replicated Targets" data-text="Maximum targets included in the replicated summary.
